Name: Proxy_Attr
Description: Will duplicate and connect all proxy attrs from desire transform

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Will duplicate and connect all proxy attrs from desire transform. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. CtrlShape: choose one option (for example: cross, gear, hexagon, octagon). SetCopyAttrsFrom: set the node/object name this block should use. Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template parent examples: L_Hand_Ankle_Jnt, L_Hand_Palm_Jnt, Spine_End_Jnt.
